excerpt: It’s a sign of the trust that i have in Bergrún Snæbjörnsdóttir’s music that, when she sent me her new album Skinweeper a few months back, i dropped everything and just pressed play. No prep, no note-reading, i didn’t even look at the track titles; i just wanted to listen,…

This morning i’m setting off for Romania, where i’ll be experiencing the cavalcade of sonic joy that is the World New Music Days. One or two things to come in my absence, and a welter of words once i get back from Bucharest.
